integrity: The finite-group and Hasse–Witt computations are reproducible; topological vanishing-cycle and prime-to-seven specialization steps use established mathematical theorems. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic seven, the stated smooth pencil and level-three monodromy are established; full 3-adic monodromy, all endomorphisms and independent verification remain open.
title: Full \(\mathrm{Sp}_4(\mathbb F_3)\) monodromy in a nowhere-ordinary genus-two pencil
